args.sql:
SELECT maintregistry, maintcostusd, cleancostusd, replacecostusd, revlossusd, 
       (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) as total_cost,
       revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0) as cost_efficiency_ratio
FROM maintenance
ORDER BY cost_efficiency_ratio ASC
LIMIT 20;

-- Let's see the distribution of cost efficiency ratios
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_records,
    AVG(revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as avg_efficiency,
    MIN(revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as min_efficiency,
    MAX(revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as max_efficiency
FROM maintenance;

-- Let's look at percentiles to understand where "poor" might be defined
SELECT 
    percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as p10,
    percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as p25,
    percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as p50,
    percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as p75,
    percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as p90
FROM maintenance;

-- Check how many records have cost efficiency < 1 (costs > revenue loss)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE revlossusd < (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd)) as poor_efficiency,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE revlossusd >= (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd)) as good_efficiency,
    COUNT(*) as total
FROM maintenance;

-- Check if there's a specific pattern - maybe cost efficiency = revlossusd / total_cost
-- and poor means below mean
SELECT 
    AVG(maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) as avg_total_cost,
    AVG(revlossusd) as avg_revloss,
    AVG(revlossusd / NULLIF((maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd), 0)) as avg_ratio
FROM maintenance;

SELECT m.maintregistry, 
       (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) as total_cost,
       p.gencapmw,
       (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / NULLIF(p.gencapmw, 0) as maintenance_cost_score
FROM maintenance m
JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
ORDER BY maintenance_cost_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

DELETE FROM maintenance 
WHERE (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) / NULLIF((SELECT gencapmw FROM plant WHERE growregistry = powerref), 0) > 300;
